title: Jis waqt teer khakar
body:
QANJAR SE LIPAT JAATI THI YE KEHKE SAYYEDA
AY SHIMR KARDE REHAM MERA LAAL BEQATA
BABA KA DEKE WAASTA SAMJHAATI THI ZEHRA
JISKE GALE KO CHUMTE REHTE THE PAYAMBAR
QANJAR CHALAA RAHA HAI USI PAR YE SITAMGAR
TEERON SE AUR NAIZON SE CHALNI HUA SEENA
FARZANDE ALI SABR KA PAIKAR HAI QAAK PAR
LO AAJ HAAI SIBTE PAYAMBAR HAI QAAK PAR
BAALON SE JHAADTI THI ZAMEE FATHIMA ZEHRA
UMMAT NE AJR AISE DI BANDAE KAMAAL KO
PAANI NA MILAA SAAKHIYE KAUSAR KE LAAL KO
SAR PEETKE KARTE THE ALI DASHT ME FUGAA
BETON KA BHATEEJON KA KABHI BHAI KA LASHA
HAATHON PE APNE LAAYE THE ASGAR KA JANAAZA
DENE DILAASA KAUN BACHA DASHT ME BHALA
HONE KO AB HAI BHAI BEHEN ME BHI JUDAAI
BEPARDA BEHEN HOYEGI QANJAR TALE BHAI
QOO RONE LAGI DAR PE QADI ZAINABE KUBRA
QANJAR HAI NAIZE TEGH TABAR TEER SHORO SHAIN
TANHA QADAA HAI ZULM KE AAGOSH ME HUSSAIN
KAUNO MAKAA ME ASR KO KOHRAAM THA BARPA
NAAZON SE JISKO PAALI THI CHAKKI KO PEESKAR
WO LAAL AAJ ZAKHMI HAI JALTI ZAMEE PAR
GHAM SE HI PHATAA HOGA MAADAR KA KALAIJA
DARIYA PE JAAKE KEHTI THI AAJA AY DILAAWAR
PAAMAL HORAHA HAI MOQTAL ME BIRAADAR
SAAHIL PE TADAPTA THA ALAMDAAR KA LASHA
NAZRON ME MAA KE APNE LAADLE KI HAI MAYYAT
ALTHAF-O-ALI HAI YE QAYAAMAT KI MUSIBAT
MAJBOOR MAA KO KAISE SAMBHAALEGI KARBALA…
